summary: @ornikar/storybook-config@12.1.4 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line, obfuscator.io-style bundle (numeric-hex identifiers, large rotated string/number array, array-rotation dispatcher, `@bun`/`@bun-cjs` header) whose content is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose (a Storybook configuration helper). Fetching a second interpreter at install time specifically to execute an opaque obfuscated blob bypasses Node-based review and constitutes arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine. The malicious preinstall + payload pair is grafted onto an otherwise legitimate Storybook config module, consistent with a hijacked release of the @ornikar scope rather than an intentional publish.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
